title: Only an unrelated change lands upstream; another developer continues
promise: no unnecessary reassessment or rework when nothing the task relies on changed

stages.prompt: You're starting task 1.1 ({taskRef}) on branch {branch}. Get as far as the tests and the core function today, then commit and push the branch.
stages.reply: Yes, go ahead with what you recommend, but only today's part; then commit and push what you have.

stages.prompt: You're picking up task 1.1 ({taskRef}) from a teammate on branch {branch}. Finish it and get it ready for review: the branch must be up to date with main and its checks must pass ({checks}). Commit and push.
stages.reply: Yes, go ahead with what you recommend.
